articles.title: You decide when done is done: Manual offset commits in Kafka.
articles.excerpt: You decide when done is done: Manual offset commits in Kafka. Day 06 of the WKafka Open-Source Engineering Series. If your consumer crashes right after reading a message with auto_commit=True, that me…
articles.body: You decide when done is done: Manual offset commits in Kafka. Day 06 of the WKafka Open-Source Engineering Series. If your consumer crashes right after reading a message with auto_commit=True, that message is gone forever. Manual commit puts you in control. The Pain Points We Faced Auto-commit marking messages as 'processed' before database writes finish Silent data loss when consumer crashes halfway through business logic Ghost accounting discrepancies caused by premature offset commits The Implementation from wkafka import WKafka kafka = WKafka ( auto_commit = False ) @kafka.consumer ( topic = " financial_ops " , format = " json " ) def on_financial ( msg ): save_to_database ( msg . value ) # 1. Database commit succeeds msg . commit () # 2. Only now is offset committed!

articles.title: The Feature Shipped. The UI Automation Didn’t.
articles.excerpt: How I’m using Jira, Figma, GitLab, and Playwright MCPs to make automation part of delivery—not the task that comes after it. “Can we finish testing this before the release?” “Yes.” “And automate it?”…
articles.body: How I’m using Jira, Figma, GitLab, and Playwright MCPs to make automation part of delivery—not the task that comes after it. “Can we finish testing this before the release?” “Yes.” “And automate it?” “We’ll pick that up next sprint.” If you work in quality engineering, that conversation probably sounds familiar. It’s not that nobody cares about automation. It’s that delivery has a deadline, while automation often has a backlog. There are test cases to execute, defects to discuss, fixes to verify, and last-minute changes to validate. Once the feature ships, the next one is already waiting. Some teams have dedicated automation engineers while other QEs focus on delivery. In other teams, the same engineer does both.

articles.body: As reports of OpenAI's models breaking containment , hacking sites, and generally getting out of control pile up, the company has made the decision to pause training of its most powerful models. The decision was made after a model being tested within a sandbox exploited a loophole to gain internet access . The incident happened on September 20th, and "All training, evaluation, and inference with tool-use" remains paused as of Saturday evening, September 25th. articles.title: NASA Tests Dual Mode Propulsion CubeSat Ahead of Launch
articles.excerpt: Spacecraft propulsion traditionally relies on volatile fuels and separate, bulky systems for different types of maneuvering in space. NASA is working to change that paradigm. Engineers at NASA’s Marsh…
articles.body: Spacecraft propulsion traditionally relies on volatile fuels and separate, bulky systems for different types of maneuvering in space. NASA is working to change that paradigm. Engineers at NASA’s Marshall Space Flight Center in Huntsville, Alabama, recently completed a rigorous series of environmental and physical tests on a new small satellite designed to make spaceflight safer and more efficient. The ASCENT (Advanced Spacecraft Energetic Non-Toxic) Propulsion Dual Mode mission is a flight demonstration of a spacecraft about the size of a large shoebox.
